sum: TAO Synergies Inc. owns and operates an AI token. It focuses on the pure play artificial intelligence (AI) crypto coin, TAO, the native cryptocurrency of Bittensor and a decentralized blockchain network for machine learning and AI. The company was formerly known as Synaptogenix, Inc. and changed its name to TAO Synergies Inc. in June 2025. TAO Synergies Inc was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
